text:
lin: kicking off telemetry provisioning for the new ap-northeast-1 GPU cluster. runbook draft is in the repo, need infra + oncall signoff before we flip ingestion.
ashok: quick context — cluster will be in our customer VPC peered to redwood-prod-vpc. need private endpoints for prometheus/loki/tempo ingestion.
maria: I'll own dashboards. planned: per-node GPU memory, pod-level token qps, inference tail-latency p99, and kv-cache hit rate panels.
sam: cost note — expected log ingest ~1.2TB/day at default verbose. recommend 7-day raw retention, 30-day compressed. can we enable sample-based indexing?
ops-sre: alerts i'll add: Prometheus node_exporter down, kubelet high cpu, inference_p99 > 300ms for 5m, loki_ingest_backlog_bytes > 100MB. include runbook steps for paging and fallback to smaller model.
lin: important networking constraints: no public internet egress from inference subnet. Fluentd/vector must ship to a VPC endpoint in telemetry-prod account. ashok — can you confirm endpoint subnets and NAT exceptions?
ashok: confirmed. created interface endpoints in ap-northeast-1a/b for loki/write, tempo/write, and prometheus remote_write. added security groups only allowing telemetry-gw. no NAT needed.
maria: dashboard template locations: repo: infra/telemetry/grafana/dashboards/new-cluster. i'll push a lightweight GPU overview and a detailed model-inference view.
sam: to reduce logs, please set inference containers to INFO and route DEBUG to a separate sampled stream. add structured JSON logs with request_id.
lin: validation plan before handoff: 1) synthetic traffic generator hitting endpoint at 10qps and 100qps 2) verify prometheus remote_write latency < 2s 3) verify loki ingestion shows < 5s write latency 4) run queries against Grafana panels and ensure panels render under 3s.
ops-sre: adding smoke alerts and a playbook: when p99 > threshold -> page oncall; if prometheus remote_write errors spike -> route traffic to fallback model pool and scale down batch size. playbook in docs/runbooks/telemetry-handoff.md.
maria: reminder: pre-create dashboard ACLs and team folders, and add grafana alerts as annotations for correlation with traces.
deploy-bot: ci:telemetry-provision pipeline triggered by lin. logs: https://ci.internal/teams/infra/pipelines/4567 :white_check_mark:
lin: handoff checklist (final): create service accounts with minimal perms, provision endpoints, deploy metrics/log forwarding, validate synthetic tests, deploy dashboards, export alert templates as json, and schedule 1-hr oncall overlap.
ashok: I pushed the terraform for endpoints and IAM roles in branch feat/telemetry-apne1. run `terraform plan` then `apply` in staging.
maria: i'll import dashboards after apply and run the rendering tests.
sam: cost mitigation: enable loki compaction and set chunk_target_size to 4MB. I'll open a ticket with finance for estimated monthly delta.
ops-sre: tagging: ensure all telemetry resources have cost_center:gpu-cluster and env:staging/prod. alerts will use those tags for routing.
lin: timeline: staging deploy today, smoke validation tonight (23:00 UTC), production flip tomorrow 02:00 UTC if all green. please ack and i'll start the apply.
ashok: ack.
maria: ack :thumbsup:
sam: ack
ops-sre: ack — i'll be oncall during smoke window.
lin: thanks team — will post post-deploy notes in this thread and attach the final runbook link.
